question_sr: Opišite proces dijagnostikovanja kvara kada mašina za brizganje plastike ne radi — kojim redosledom postupate?
question_en: Describe how you'd diagnose a fault when a plastic injection machine isn't working — in what order do you proceed?

question_sr: Prepoznajte i objasnite glavne komponente hidrauličnog sistema (pumpe, ventili, motori, rezervoar).
question_en: Identify and explain the main components of a hydraulic system (pumps, valves, motors, reservoir).

question_sr: Skicirajte ili opišite jednostavnu električnu šemu sa izvorom napajanja, prekidačem i potrošačem (npr. sijalicom). Kojim redosledom je proveravate u slučaju kvara?
question_en: Sketch or describe a simple electrical schematic with a power source, switch, and consumer (e.g. a lightbulb). In what order would you check it during a fault?

question_sr: Stigli ste kod klijenta, mašina ne radi. Šta radite kao prvi korak?
question_en: You arrive at the client site and the machine isn't working. What's your first step?

question_sr: Opišite slučaj kada ste sami doneli odluku o popravci bez podrške.
question_en: Describe a time you made a repair decision on your own without backup support.

question_sr: Niste sigurni u rešenje, podrška se ne javlja, klijent čeka — kako komunicirate odlaganje intervencije?
question_en: You're unsure of the fix, support isn't responding, the client is waiting — how do you communicate the delay?

question_sr: Klijent ima primedbu zbog kašnjenja rezervnog dela. Kako objašnjavate situaciju?
question_en: A client complains about a delayed spare part. How do you explain the situation?

question_sr: Opišite najtežu komunikaciju sa klijentom koju ste imali — šta biste uradili drugačije?
question_en: Describe the toughest customer interaction you've had — what would you do differently?

question_sr: Klijent insistira da odmah popravite, ali bezbedno ne možete bez delova. Kako reagujete?
question_en: A client insists you fix the machine immediately, but you can't safely do so without parts. How do you respond?

question_sr: Šta vas drži motivisanim u terenskom servisu, daleko od kuće, pod pritiskom?
question_en: What keeps you motivated in field service, working away from home and under pressure?

question_sr: Šta su za vas primeri dobrih brend praksi? Dajte konkretan primer i objasnite zašto smatrate da je uspešan.
question_en: What are examples of good brand practices in your view? Give a concrete example and explain why you think it's successful.

question_sr: Koja je razlika između brenda i proizvoda?
question_en: What's the difference between a brand and a product?

question_sr: Koji digitalni kanali su trenutno najefikasniji za izgradnju brenda u FMCG sektoru i zašto?
question_en: Which digital channels are currently most effective for building a brand in the FMCG sector, and why?

question_sr: Kako biste pristupili lansiranju nove varijante postojećeg proizvoda — koji su prvi koraci?
question_en: How would you approach launching a new variant of an existing product — what are the first steps?

question_sr: Kako merite šta funkcioniše u brend kampanji, a šta ne?
question_en: How do you measure what works in a brand campaign vs. what doesn't?

question_sr: Da li ste više timski ili individualni igrač? Dajte konkretan primer iz prakse.
question_en: Are you more of a team player or individual player? Give a concrete example.

question_sr: Opišite situaciju u kojoj se prioritet projekta promenio u toku rada. Kako ste se prilagodili?
question_en: Describe a situation where a project priority changed mid-execution. How did you adapt?

question_sr: Pričajte o vremenu kada se vaše mišljenje razlikovalo od menadžera ili kolega. Kako ste rešili razliku?
question_en: Tell us about a time your view differed from your manager's or a colleague's. How did you resolve it?

question_sr: Imate tri zadatka sa istim rokom i ne stižete sve. Kako odlučujete šta ide prvo?
question_en: You have three tasks with the same deadline and can't finish them all. How do you decide what comes first?

question_sr: Šta vas motivira u marketinškom poslu, a šta vas iscrpljuje?
question_en: What energises you about marketing work, and what drains you?
